matchedRuns.scope: Same answer, question/rubric source and fixed label; provider-only. Status does not affect inclusion.

pilotReference.label: v2
pilotReference.exposureSemantics: All exposure groups are relative only to the initial pilot. previously_unrun_question means not in that initial pilot; previously_unrun_by_provider means not provider-assessed in that initial pilot. These keys do not imply that a question was unseen in any later development run.

safeguards: Only whitelisted score, diagnostic-code and provenance metadata is exported; full feedback, answer text and model reasoning remain in workspace reports.
Fixed labels and raw score discrepancies are unchanged. Adjudication notes are qualitative cautions, not retroactive corrections.
Provider metrics exclude deterministic blanks/review guards; tag groups overlap and must not be summed.
Legacy v1 absence of later losses/quality fields is a contract difference, not a newly generated diagnostic error.
Exposure groups refer only to the initial pilot. Later full-corpus reruns follow development review of earlier runs; no untouched or teacher-certified holdout is claimed.

adjudication.note: Fixed gold is 2. A mechanism-only answer goes beyond naming, but the 2-mark descriptor can require some effect or prevention. A score of 1 is defensible under that reading; teacher/rubric adjudication is needed.

The low-consistency expectation may conflate a false consequence claim with internal contradiction. High consistency with low technical accuracy is defensible; the mechanical quality flag is not a validated error.

Fixed gold is 1. The 2-mark descriptor asks for one well-described approach and identification of the other. Crediting the correct top-down explanation plus the bottom-up name, despite its wrong description, is a defensible alternative interpretation.

Historical v3 review: diagram quality was reduced partly for absent attributes, a content omission; the full diagram with the same layout received a higher visual-quality rating. The feedback also cited spacing, so the exact value is subjective. Inspect each later run separately before claiming this issue persists.
